text_block_list.text: Here we are again. The Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I've grown up a lot since last
year, haven't
I, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: I think you're pretty much all grown up now.

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Really? Like, for real? ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But there are parts of me that haven't
changed
much.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Like the fact that I wanna twinkle in the
Twinkle
Series!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So you have to keep your eyes on me
until the
very end. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna shine brighter than anyone
else! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh, hello Brian! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...If it isn't Маяно Топ Ган.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey! ☆ You remember my name?! Whoa!
Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Tch... Your name is just stuck in my head
after
racing against you so many times.
That's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I see. Well then, just so you
know, I'm your
real opponent today.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you so excited you
forget all your
pent-up stress and
gloominess!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: You'll be totally entranced!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh! Read you like a book! I'm good at
that,
y'know!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Still, there's something I don't
understand yet.
You've always twinkled
so brightly.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna beat you.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Because I wanna twinkle even brighter
than you.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And when I do, I'll definitely send your
heart
aflutter.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Fine, come at me. I'll grind you to dust.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hehe! ☆ Right back at ya! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna lose!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
